N23812822.raw_response: {"core_themes": "This folder contains joint weekly reports and political updates on Brazil from September 1963 to January 1964, produced amid the Goulart government’s mounting political and military tensions. The reports track cabinet reform pressures, relations among the Partido Social Democrático (PSD) and Partido Trabalhista Brasileiro (PTB), and political maneuvering involving Governor Carlos Lacerda and Leonel Brizola. They also record rumors and controversies, including the Jacarepagua arms investigation, alongside reports of a senator’s assassination and the imprisonment of union leaders.
